snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk 1.26 V0.20 New Menu Shellmap
snippet.description:
Re-addition of the shellmap in Kane's Wrath. I thought this was almost impossible when I first started out on this as there's no released / known Kane's Wrath menu flash source files, so making the original menu itself "disappear" completely seemed unlikely. However after 2-3 days of work, I managed to build something that looks competent whilst still using the original Kane's Wrath menu source. I'm very happy with the result! 
Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
Discord server: https://discord.gg/8Cpfepqczy
